title: Frozen Direct-rule STOP-gate transfer and learned Bellman action-gap diagnostics on new Horn grammars

frozen.source_pins: Use original AF25 original_artifact checksum gates, original AF23 ReadoutPolicy('ancestor',4), unchanged AF23 score_from_nodes numerical recurrence; no new training, validation selection or model head tuning.
frozen.model_visible: Public 15 physical atoms, at most 14 Horn rule slots, four initially known logical facts (positive and negative), 6/13 subgoal marks and 14 goal mark; no oracle truth labels at inference.
frozen.batch_sensitive: Archive each scored model node ledger and selected action. Regenerate from fixed source, record top-two margin, exact score gaps and count sub-1e-5 ambiguities; sample frozen forward replay with tolerance. No original AF25/DD result parity is expected on NEW grammars.

graph.initial_facts_negative: Exactly four: replace critical root fact 2 with one of 7,8,10,11, verifying unreachability under every family/depth.

constructors.forked_and: A shared-precursor goal rule requiring both subgoal6 and subgoal13 competes with a single-premise alternate goal rule built from a longer chain, with mandatory critical-root atom 2. Depth 5 and 6 variants add different productive AND prerequisites.
constructors.or_gate: Two distinct legal goal rules, one from subgoal13 and another from an extended path requiring critical-root atom2. Goal route alternation and gate arity differ from earlier AF25 two-AND-goal family.

graph.permutation: Deterministic public atom and rule slot permutations keyed by case_id; no neural or symbolic score is used in generator.

ND.stop: Always continue if a legal rule exists

BFS_NODE_MATCHED.type: Public host breadth-first search with expansion cap equal to number of unique nodes in the original neural two-step lookahead at that exact state; public-only cap, no neural predictions or oracle costs

BFS64.type: Public breadth-first search with 64 expanded host states per decision, expensive diagnostic

SHORTEST.type: Evaluation-only exact BFS proof oracle; not passed as an inference feature

action_budgets.provable: Exactly independently proved shortest rule-firing distance +1
action_budgets.gate_vs_rule: Source-specific native binary STOP decision; keep Direct legal-rule ranking for DD,VD,ND. Use original AF26 factor function and source AF23 score recurrence.
action_budgets.terminal: STOP if no legal rule, terminate if goal in state

primary.claim: Does the unmodified VI2 STOP gate improve negative immediate STOP while preserving the original Direct-ranked positive proofs on genuinely new graph topologies?
primary.target: VD vs DD, per source seed at both depths
primary.rule: For one seed to pass, VD correct initial STOP on unprovable >= DD+7, VD completed provable >= DD-4, and zero false proofs at BOTH held depths. Require 6/8 seed passes. Any source/audit failure yields INCONCLUSIVE; complete study else TRANSFER_FAIL.
primary.interpretation: Only finite source-registered synthetic Horn grammar transfer; registration does not imply a model search capability advantage.

secondary.rule_gap: At each *initial provable* host state, compute the highest versus second-highest legal rule native margins for Direct and VI2, log original preferred rule, compare against independently computed optimal root actions offline. Report counts of correct/rank-discordant cases and per-seed paired margins.
secondary.per_step_rule_gap: For every visited state in the chosen DD/VD/VV policies, log native within-legal rule score margins and STOP gap, top rule identities, VI2 interior STOP binding, root suboptimal legal action decisions, and host graph node work.
secondary.truth_separation: Host shortest/optimal labels used only in post hoc audit metrics and action budget, never in model or symbolic inference.
secondary.statistical_unit: Per seed and per unique graph; repeated deterministic graph test outcomes across eight model seeds are correlated.
secondary.compute: For BFS_NODE_MATCHED equalize unique public host-state evaluation count to neural two-step node count per decision, with separate rule-examinations/CPU time. This matches counted states only, not FLOPs or latency. Include BFS64.

evidence.source_lock: Freeze protocol/source/structural manifest before new model scoring. Changes as dated amendments only, never weaken scientific criteria based on heldout outcomes.
evidence.replay: Check all original AF23 checkpoint archive ZIP/member SHA256, Torch/NumPy parity and original training source hashes. Independent physical-incidence host proof replay, exact distance and register gates, sampled true frozen forward.
evidence.full_artifact: Per-episode rows, per-state nodes, original chosen scores and rule margins, all eight seeds, source hashes, comparisons and parent citations.
evidence.retain_prior: Keep AF22-26 original reports and registered outcomes unchanged.
